definition.goal: Compare the existing fixed-threshold integer and finite-helper CONFIG paths with the same infinity-helper output: prove both directions for every positive threshold, identify the endpoint ordering for item infinity-degree two, and transfer the explicit InfDegreeTwo family to the actual DegreeThree intersection guarantee with ConfigOPT=T, integer OPT=floor(sqrt(T)), and all added players N=T^3+T; preserve the finite-helper boundary and recompute the exponent. Separately inspect the original M-LP definition used by the old InfDegreeTwo statement: decide exactly what the CONFIG bridge does or does not establish for that distinct relaxation, including threshold loss and additional obligations, instead of identifying the relaxations or their variable maps by name.
